title: Circuit Breaker State Machine & Microservice Resilience
description: The circuit-breaker security module implements fault tolerance for Rust microservices (ferrox-circuit-breaker). It features a finite state machine (Closed, Open, HalfOpen), failure threshold monitoring, automatic recovery probing, and fallback execution pipelines.
